build._comment_watch: Only these paths trigger a redeploy. A redeploy restarts the bot, and while it is down the bot-managed stop is not enforced - only the exchange-side OTO stop is. There is no reason to take that window for a README edit.

deploy._comment_restart: ALWAYS: the bot re-adopts open positions on startup, so a restart is recoverable; being down is not.
deploy._comment_healthcheck: Deliberately no healthcheckPath. This is a worker with no HTTP listener - setting one would fail every deploy. Liveness is the Telegram heartbeat.
